title: add downgrade guard, version pinning and robust backup/restore for private-installer (helm & terraform)
author: Priya Patel
description:
Motivation: customers deploying Redwood Private reported a risky downgrade path and occasional failed upgrades due to missing pre-upgrade backups and out-of-order schema migrations. This PR implements a downgrade guard + version pinning for the installer, automatic backup-before-upgrade hooks for Helm, Terraform validation for pinned module versions, and safer schema migration primitives with explicit pre/post hooks.

Summary of changes: added a Helm pre-upgrade Job that takes a consistent Postgres backup to S3/GCS before any migration runs; introduced a "downgrade_guard" controller that records the highest-applied migration version and prevents installer from applying a release with an older pinned version unless the guard is explicitly disabled; added version pinning variables and validation to Terraform modules used by private deployments; migrated DB schema tooling to use an explicit migrations table and advisory locking to avoid concurrent migration runs; added rollback helper scripts and a documented restore path; expanded the installer smoke tests and CI upgrade-matrix to cover upgrade->downgrade scenarios.

Checklist: [x] Helm hooks for pre/post backup and smoke test [x] Migration table + advisory lock + rollback scripts [x] Terraform variable validation for pinned versions [x] Downgrade guard implementation + admin override [x] E2E tests for upgrade/rollback matrix [x] Documentation and release notes entry

Why this is safe: backups are taken as a K8s Job with a TTL and explicit exit codes; migrations acquire Postgres advisory locks and write a migration_version row atomically; the downgrade guard prevents accidental rollbacks that would apply an incompatible image/schema combo. The change is opt-out for existing customers (downgrade_guard: true by default; cluster admins can set downgrade_guard: false), and operators are required to explicitly pass a "force_downgrade=true" flag in the installer CLI to bypass the protection after acknowledging risk.
